scientific_question: Are original native forest fragments geographically and elevationally segregated from mixed/exotic stands across Azores islands, making native versus modified forest ecological richness contrasts non-identifiable independently of altitude?
grain: 45 physical SLAM plots (Corvo 1, Flores 5, Santa Maria 16, Terceira 23), one original Event per physical locationID; never count arthropod individuals or site pairs as independent physical replicates.

original_habitat_rule.if_unknown: STOP entire environmental source audit, no invented label

elevation_rule.within_island_effect: median elevation native minus median altered among independent source sites, no parametric or pair-wise significance claimed.
elevation_rule.common_elevation_interval: closed interval of intersection between native and altered original observed plot elevation min-max, report null if disjoint
elevation_rule.per_island_biological_estimability_floor: Need >=2 native and >=2 modified plot elevations WITHIN common interval
elevation_rule.between_island_biological_estimability_f: Need >=2 ISLANDS independently satisfying per-island common support before any species response can be opened in v1.336
elevation_rule.source_site_sampling_method: All source original samplingProtocol strings must represent SLAM interception and remain enumerated, but sampling duration differences mean no original taxon values read before independent equal-effort rule.
elevation_rule.source_calendar: EventDate must start with YYYY and original source year field if present must agree, only source 2019-2020.

fallback_on_failure: If fewer than 2 original islands meet strict common elevation support, commit site-only positive landscape sorting result and scientific TERMINAL for habitat-induced endemic/introduced species response. Do not loosen plot count, add 2024 sites, combine authors' existing samples or fit across zero-support via extrapolation.

interpretation.positive_landscape_observation: Document original per-island native vs modified site count, native and modified median/range elevations, direction and common-support. This is an ecological distribution of available forest habitats, although association itself is already alluded to in Borges 2022 and Tsafack 2021 prior art.
interpretation.do_not_claim: Landscape sorting alone cannot establish forest richness impact, origin-specific species loss, historical refuge function or habitat rescue. BALA temporal and SLAM source biodiversity outputs are not paired in this audit.
